answer: The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in whisper, expire in saffron, and garden lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 87 aliases as a result needs 71 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 157 dollars in locked collateral and another 7 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
